_meta.title: Interactive Manifest Data Patterns
_meta.purpose: The 13 data-pattern signatures used to label each captured interactive in {MODULE_CODE}_interactives.txt, so the later build phase knows the shape of the captured data at a glance. Format heritage: 00-PageForge/PageForge Phases/phase4_message.md (format only — no code reuse). ManifestBuilder.js reads THIS file.
_meta.detection: Patterns are scored against the captured bundle: widget type membership (strongest signal), presence of a data TABLE, and which SUBTAG canonical tags occur among the members. Highest score wins; a tie or zero score → pattern 0 (unclassified) + a red flag recorded on the entry — never silently guessed.
_meta.extension_rule: New widget shape = edit/add a pattern entry here, never a code change.

unclassified.name: Unclassified
unclassified.rule: No pattern matched confidently. The manifest entry carries a red flag telling the later phase to read the captured data manually.

tiers.rule: Kept for later phases per brief §8.3 — in Phase 1 ALL interactives are placeholder-only (no Tier-1 rendering). The classification is still stamped on each entry so later phases can route work.
